description: IS [NOT] DISTINCT FROM truth table / WHERE / join-on-nullable-keys, and LAG/LEAD with offsets and defaults. Converted 1:1 from query/IsDistinctFromTest and LagLeadTest (both now retired; the LagLead queries gained a query-level ORDER BY id matching their window order so positional row asserts are deterministic).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE pairs (id INTEGER, a INTEGER, b INTEGER)
INSERT INTO pairs VALUES (1, 1, 1), (2, 1, 2), (3, 1, NULL), (4, NULL, NULL)
SELECT id, IFF(a IS DISTINCT FROM b, 'T', 'F'), IFF(a IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b, 'T', 'F') FROM pairs ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE pairs (id INTEGER, a INTEGER, b INTEGER)
INSERT INTO pairs VALUES (1, 1, 1), (2, 1, 2), (3, 1, NULL), (4, NULL, NULL)
SELECT id FROM pairs WHERE a IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM pairs WHERE a = b ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE l (k INTEGER, lv VARCHAR)
CREATE TABLE r (k INTEGER, rv VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO l VALUES (1, 'l1'), (NULL, 'lnull')
INSERT INTO r VALUES (1, 'r1'), (NULL, 'rnull'), (2, 'r2')
SELECT l.lv, r.rv FROM l JOIN r ON l.k IS NOT DISTINCT FROM r.k ORDER BY l.lv
CREATE TABLE pairs (id INTEGER, a INTEGER, b INTEGER)
INSERT INTO pairs VALUES (1, 1, 1), (2, 1, 2), (3, 1, NULL), (4, NULL, NULL)
SELECT id FROM pairs WHERE (a IS DISTINCT FROM b) AND NOT (a IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 999) ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE sales (id INTEGER, product VARCHAR, sale_date VARCHAR, amount INTEGER)
SELECT product, sale_date, amount, LAG(amount) OVER (ORDER BY id) as prev_amount FROM sales ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE sales (id INTEGER, product VARCHAR, sale_date VARCHAR, amount INTEGER)
SELECT product, sale_date, amount, LEAD(amount) OVER (ORDER BY id) as next_amount FROM sales ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE sales (id INTEGER, product VARCHAR, sale_date VARCHAR, amount INTEGER)
SELECT id, amount, LAG(amount, 2) OVER (ORDER BY id) as lag2_amount FROM sales ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE sales (id INTEGER, product VARCHAR, sale_date VARCHAR, amount INTEGER)
SELECT id, amount, LEAD(amount, 2) OVER (ORDER BY id) as lead2_amount FROM sales ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE sales (id INTEGER, product VARCHAR, sale_date VARCHAR, amount INTEGER)
SELECT id, amount, LAG(amount, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY id) as prev_amount FROM sales ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE sales (id INTEGER, product VARCHAR, sale_date VARCHAR, amount INTEGER)
SELECT id, amount, LEAD(amount, 1, -1) OVER (ORDER BY id) as next_amount FROM sales ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE sales (id INTEGER, product VARCHAR, sale_date VARCHAR, amount INTEGER)
SELECT id, amount, LAG(amount) OVER (ORDER BY id) as prev_amount, LEAD(amount) OVER (ORDER BY id) as next_amount FROM sales ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE sales (id INTEGER, product VARCHAR, sale_date VARCHAR, amount INTEGER)
SELECT sale_date, amount, LAG(sale_date) OVER (ORDER BY id) as prev_date FROM sales ORDER BY id
